tools.name: connect_promise
tools.description: Return a Promise signup URL for users who want agent access to follow-up memory. Safety: Never collects provider credentials in the agent. Send the user to Promise.

tools.name: get_today
tools.description: Return what currently deserves the user's attention. Safety: Return concise items and links back to Promise for sensitive action.

tools.name: list_commitments
tools.description: List what the user owes and what the user is waiting on. Safety: Do not infer more certainty than Promise returns.

tools.name: get_commitment
tools.description: Retrieve a structured Promise commitment or waiting-on item. Safety: Prefer structured status, due dates, people, and source links over raw mail.

tools.name: get_commitment_evidence
tools.description: Show why Promise believes a follow-up or memory exists. Safety: Return source summaries and citations permitted by the platform API.

tools.name: get_person_context
tools.description: Summarize what matters before the user speaks with someone. Safety: Avoid exposing hidden/private fields unless the platform scopes allow them.

tools.name: search_memory
tools.description: Search Promise's derived memory with user authorization. Safety: Search derived Promise memory, not raw provider mailboxes.

tools.name: capture_note
tools.description: Let a user tell Promise something to remember. Safety: Echo what Promise understood and require review when the platform requests it.

tools.name: create_follow_up
tools.description: Create a future follow-up from explicit user intent. Safety: Only create follow-ups from explicit user instructions.

tools.name: mark_resolved
tools.description: Tell Promise that a commitment or waiting-on item is complete. Safety: Confirm destructive or irreversible status changes in the agent UI.

tools.name: draft_follow_up
tools.description: Draft a follow-up message without sending it. Safety: Do not send email in v1. Return a draft and Promise confirmation link.
